title: Remina- Evaluation of a digital aftercare program for psychosomatic rehabilitation
summary:
The Remina study accompanies a pilot project that offers digital aftercare for people with psychosomatic conditions funded by the German Pension Fund. Its aim is to find out whether the digital aftercare program Rethera Mind can be implemented successfully and effectively.
The study examines how Rethera Mind affects psychological and physical symptoms and self-rated ability to work in people with depression, anxiety, stress-related conditions, or somatic symptom disorders. The study also looks at broader aspects of mental and social well-being, as well as symptoms related to the specific conditions. To understand how well the digital program works in everyday life, the study considers how often participants take part in group sessions, how actively they use the app and how satisfied they are with the program. The effectiveness and feasibility of Rethera Mind are evaluated by comparing three groups: people who take part in the digital aftercare with Rethera Mind, people who receive traditional in-person aftercare (Psy-RENA), and people who do not participate in any psychosomatic aftercare offered by the German Pension Fund.
Additionally, the study examines how the digital aftercare program Rethera Mind is received by staff at the rehabilitation clinic and in aftercare, as well as the effort required to carry out the aftercare with Rethera Mind.
conditions: Psychosomatic rehabilitation patients with depressive disorders (F32.x, F33.x [außer F32.3, F33.3], F34.1, F31.3), neurotic, stress-related, and/or somatoform disorders (F40.x, F41.0, F41.1, F41.2, F41.3, F41.8, F41.9, F43.2, F45.0, F48.0) as the main or secondary diagnosis

interventions.name: Intervention group: 6-month digital psychosomatic aftercare program 'Rethera Mind' (individual digital admission and offboarding session (50 minutes each), 25 weekly digital group sessions (60 minutes each), independent app use)
Active control group: Face-to-face psychosomatic aftercare program 'Psy-RENA' (individual admission and discharge session (50 minutes each) 25 weekly group sessions (90 minutes each))
Passive control group: No DRV-funded psychosomatic aftercare

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients:
- Completed inpatient or outpatient rehabilitation within the past ≤ 12 weeks
- Diagnosis of a depressive disorder (F32.x, F33.x [excluding F32.3, F33.3], F34.1, F31.3) and/or a neurotic, stress-related, or somatoform disorder (F40.x, F41.0, F41.1, F41.2, F41.3, F41.8, F41.9, F43.2, F45.0, F48.0) as the main or secondary diagnosis

Staff
- Therapeutic or administrative role in the preparation or delivery of the digital aftercare program Rethera Mind
- Direct contact with patients in daily work
- Use of the digital application(s) for the aftercare with Rethera Mind as part of daily work routines
Exclusion criteria:
Patients:
- Acute suicidality or a recent suicide attempt
- Acute severe psychiatric disorder
- Substance use disorder with lack of abstinence
Applicable only to digital aftercare with Rethera Mind or conventional aftercare with Psy-RENA:
- Insufficient treatment adherence and/or insufficient treatment motivation
Applicable only to digital aftercare with Rethera Mind:
- Pathological internet or computer use
- Cognitive or motor impairments that prevent use of the app
- Lack of required technical resources (e.g., suitable device, internet access) or insufficient digital literacy
